intent: Assemble the minimum sufficient, traceable Context Package for a Work Unit, preserving provenance and allowing targeted context requests.
steps: Apply the context hierarchy: constitution policies relevant to the role and Work Unit
Include project scope, architecture and constraints at project level
Include requirements, contracts and decisions for the affected capability or components at zone level
Include Work Unit objective, expected behavior, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and relevant files, symbols and tests at Work Unit level
Avoid dumping the entire repository or every document when narrower context is sufficient
Create or update a Context Package object containing each item source, provenance and reason for inclusion
Emit a context request or clarification request when required information is absent; do not fill gaps by guesswork
invariants: Preserve provenance for every included item
Do not invent missing authoritative information
Prefer minimum sufficient context over exhaustive dumps
